required_repair_contract: Use stable built-in control flow without consumer source or CSS/SCSS edits. Preserve actual element nesting, classes, attributes, interpolation, events, SVG namespace and projection selectors.
Keep tab and paginator iteration by item identity and index aliases; compare insertion/removal/reorder/view identity against untouched historical semantics, including duplicate item handling.
Retain tab label template fallback/projection and the independent determinate/indeterminate SVG circle instances.
For switch cases, verify boolean/string value domains and strict/loose behavior applicability before translating; preserve non-case siblings such as form-field required markers.
Use immutable tagged structure/style oracles and meaningful negative controls; preserve old receipts and requalify source dependencies changed by templates.
Run actual component/AOT/packed/browser cases in final Actions once development is plausibly complete; no static-only rendering claim.
implementation: Nine templates use built-in flow. A private, view-scoped public-IterableDiffers adapter preserves option identities and values, including duplicates/custom differ behavior. The original paginator source and constructor are byte-identical to the parent. No stylesheet changes.
scoped_lifecycle_decision: The new private adapter invokes IterableDiffer.onDestroy when its view disappears. Original16/minimum NgFor did not invoke that custom callback. Cleanup is a deliberate resource-lifetime improvement, independently asserted; removing cleanup fails a native negative control. No consumer constructor/HTML/CSS/SCSS edits required.
deferred_tests: Added actual paginator duplicate-identity component case and tab reorder/ARIA component case are unexecuted pending final Actions.
Full owned native/AOT/packed/floors/G11/full audit are not qualified by the focused JIT/source probes.
